```python
    suffix_sum = [0] * n

    for i in range(1, n):
        prefix_sum[i] = arr[i]
        for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1):
            if arr[j] < arr[i]:
                prefix_sum[i] = max(prefix_sum[i], arr[i] + prefix_sum[j])
    
    # Fill suffix_sum from right to left
    suffix_sum[k] = arr[k]
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        suffix_sum[i] = arr[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n):

                suffix_sum[i] = max(suffix_sum[i], arr[i] + suffix_sum[j])
```

```python
def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2 # Start with a big gap, which is half of the length of the array.

    # Do an insertion sort for the chosen gap.
    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):
            temp = arr[i]
            j = i
            # Shift the elements of arr[0..i-1], that are greater than temp, to one position ahead of their current position
            while j >= gap and arr[j - gap] > temp:
                arr[j] = arr[j - gap]
                j -= gap
            arr[j] = temp
            # Reduce the gap by half for the next gap.

    return arr
```
